init.title: Configure Bermuda
init.description:
Bermuda can currently see:
- {device_counter_active} active out of {device_counter_devices} bluetooth devices.
- {scanner_counter_active} active out of {scanner_counter_scanners} bluetooth scanner devices.

{status}

data.max_area_radius: Max radius in metres for simple AREA detection
data.max_velocity: Max Velocity in metres per second - ignore readings that imply movement away faster than this limit. 3m/s (10km/h) is good.
data.devtracker_nothome_timeout: Devtracker Timeout in seconds to consider a device as `Not Home`.
data.update_interval: Update Interval - How often (in seconds) to update sensor readings.
data.smoothing_samples: Smoothing Samples - how many samples to use for smoothing distance readings.
data.attenuation: Attenuation - Environment attenuation factor for distance calculation/calibration.
data.ref_power: Reference Power - Default rssi at 1 metre distance, for distance calibration.
data.configured_devices: Configured Devices - Select which Bluetooth devices or Beacons to track with Sensors.
data.fingerprint_foreign_spot_penalty: Fingerprint penalty for spots of other devices (dB)

data_description.max_area_radius: In the simple `AREA` feature, a device will be marked as being in the AREA of it's closest receiver, if inside this radius. If you set it small, devices will go to `unknown` between receivers, but if large devices will always appear as in their closest Area.
data_description.max_velocity: If a reading implies a device is moving away faster than this, we ignore that reading. Humans normally walk at 1.4m/s, if they're holding scissors they move at 3m/s.
data_description.devtracker_nothome_timeout: How quickly to mark device_tracker entities as `not_home` after we stop seeing advertisements. 30 to 300 seconds is probably good.
data_description.update_interval: Shortening distances will still trigger immediately, but increasing distances will be rate limited by this to reduce how much your database grows.
data_description.smoothing_samples: How many samples to average distance smoothing. Bigger numbers make for slower distance increases. Shortening distances are not affected. 10 or 20 seems good.
data_description.attenuation: After setting ref_power at 1 metre, adjust attenuation so that other distances read correctly - more or less.
data_description.ref_power: Put your most-common beacon 1 metre (3.28') away from your most-common proxy / scanner. Adjust ref_power until the distance sensor shows a lowest (not average) distance of 1 metre.
data_description.fingerprint_mode: RSSI fingerprinting. `off`: no matching and no fingerprint sensors. `shadow`: a separate Fingerprint room sensor, Bermuda's Area is unchanged. `override`: Area and Floor follow the fingerprint room when it is confident and mapped to an HA area, otherwise Bermuda's nearest-proxy result.
data_description.fingerprint_method: `knn` (default): compares absolute RSSI levels with every recorded spot; robust when more or fewer far scanners are heard. `bayes`: naive Bayes with a heard/not-heard term; can be sharper but leans on how many weak scanners are heard.
data_description.fingerprint_offset_max: Estimate a per-device level offset (phone in a pocket, another transmitter) up to this many dB. 0 (default) disables it: between adjacent rooms the absolute level is often the only difference.
data_description.fingerprint_outlier_db: If even the nearest recorded spot is farther than this (RMS dB over the heard scanners), the position is not covered by any spot and Bermuda's nearest-proxy area is used. Default 10. 0 disables the check.
data_description.fingerprint_foreign_spot_penalty: Spots recorded with another device count as this many dB farther away than they are, so a device prefers its own spots. Only applied when the device has recorded spots itself, so a device without own spots uses all spots as before. Spots without a stored recording device are never penalised. Default 8: a foreign spot only wins where the device has no own spot nearby. 0 disables it.
data_description.fingerprint_min_confidence: Below this smoothed room probability the nearest-proxy area is used. Default 0.5.
data_description.fingerprint_preset: How fast the fingerprint room follows a move. `fast`: about 5 s, more flicker. `balanced` (default): about 8 s. `stable`: about 13 s, least flicker (the fp4 behaviour). `custom`: use the four values below. The values below are ignored unless this is `custom`.
data_description.fingerprint_live_window: Seconds of readings per scanner whose median forms the live vector (3-30). The Shelly proxies report about every 3 s per scanner, so 6-12 s holds 2-4 readings. Shorter reacts faster but is noisier. fast 6, balanced 8, stable 12.
data_description.fingerprint_smoothing_tau: Time constant of the exponential smoothing of the room probabilities (0-30 s, 0 = none). The main speed/flicker trade-off. fast 2, balanced 3, stable 6.
data_description.fingerprint_confirm_cycles: Update cycles (about 1 s each) a new room must lead by a margin before it is shown (1-10). A very confident new room switches at once. fast 1, balanced 2, stable 3.
data_description.fingerprint_min_dwell: Minimum seconds between two room switches (0-60). fast 3, balanced 3, stable 5.

selectdevices.title: Select Devices
selectdevices.description: Choose which devices you wish to track. If no devices appear below, then Bermuda is not seeing any data coming from Bluetooth scanners. Ensure you have an esphome ble_proxy device, Shelly devices with bluetooth proxy configured or a local bluetooth adaptor.

calibration1_global.title: Calibration 1: Global

data_description.save_and_close: After you are happy with the calibration, check this box and click Submit. Your changes will be saved, and you can proceed to the next calibration step. Leave this box un-checked while you adjust and test the settings.
data_description.attenuation: After adjusting the above settings for 1m distance readings, move the device further away (for example 5 metres) and adust the attenuation until the calculated distances match the physical distance between the scanner and device. Click submit to see the new distance estimations.
data_description.ref_power: To calibrate this setting, place the device 1 metre from the scanner, and adjust the value until the figures above reflect that 1m distance. Note that values will only recompute after clicking submit, and a more-negative number will result in a lower distance

calibration2_scanners.title: Calibration 2: Per-Scanner RSSI Offsets
calibration2_scanners.description:
This step is optional but useful if your scanners have different sensitivities or varying antenna performance. Adjust the offset rssi for each scanner until the calculated distance to the selected device is correct. Leave the scanner you used in your "reference pair" in step 1 at Zero.

{suffix}

data_description.scanner_info: Leave at zero to accept the global default, or enter a non-zero number to offset the rssi reported by that scanner. Adjust until the estimated distance above matches the actual distance between that scanner and the selected transmitting device. Negative values will increase the distance, positive values will decrease it.

dump_devices.name: Dump Devices
dump_devices.description: Returns the internal data structure, optionally limited to the given address(es). Includes the rssi and other info from each scanner

addresses.name: Addresses
addresses.description: An optional space-separated list of MAC addresses to return info on. If blank get all addresses.

configured_devices.name: Configured Devices
configured_devices.description: Select to include only scanners and configured devices in the output.

redact.name: Redact
redact.description: Set to TRUE to ensure MAC addresses are redacted in output for privacy.

record_fingerprint.name: Record fingerprint
record_fingerprint.description: Record an RSSI fingerprint (spot) for a room while the device stays at one position. Give an area_id (or a free-text room), or a spot_id to re-record an existing spot.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: Home Assistant area the spot belongs to.

room.name: Room
room.description: Area name, or a free-text room label for places that are not HA areas (used when area_id is empty).

label.name: Label
label.description: Name of the spot. Leave empty to auto-number (Spot 1, Spot 2, ...).

spot_id.name: Spot ID
spot_id.description: Re-record this existing spot (keeps its room and label). Its samples, and the device stored with it, are replaced by the new recording.

device.name: Device
device.description: Bermuda device address, name or device ID. Defaults to the only tracked device. Stored with the spot.

carry.name: Carry
carry.description: How the device is carried during the recording.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Replace an existing spot with the same label in the same room (whichever device recorded it). Off: always add a new spot.

cancel_fingerprint.name: Cancel fingerprint recording
cancel_fingerprint.description: Stop the running recording without saving it.

delete_fingerprint.name: Delete fingerprint
delete_fingerprint.description: Delete one spot, by spot_id or by room plus label.

spot_id.name: Spot ID
spot_id.description: ID of the spot to delete.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room name or label of the spot.

clear_fingerprints.name: Clear fingerprints
clear_fingerprints.description: Delete all spots of one room, or of every room with all. Their raw recording files are deleted too.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room name or label to clear.

all.name: All rooms
all.description: Delete every spot of every room (and all raw recording files) instead of one room.

list_fingerprints.name: List fingerprints
list_fingerprints.description: Return all rooms and spots (without raw windows). Raw readings of each recording are in raw_dir (.storage/bermuda_fingerprints_raw/<spot_id>.json).

evaluate_fingerprints.name: Evaluate fingerprints
evaluate_fingerprints.description: Leave-one-spot-out accuracy of the matcher on the recorded spots, compared with the nearest-proxy baseline.

use_offset.name: Use device offset
use_offset.description: Off forces the offset cap to 0.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Softmax temperature for the room posterior (default: the method's tuned value).

method.name: Method
method.description: Matcher to evaluate (default: the configured one).

offset_max.name: Offset cap
offset_max.description: Device offset cap in dB (0 = off; default: configured).

outlier_db.name: Outlier distance
outlier_db.description: Outlier threshold in dB (0 = off; default: configured).

foreign_penalty.name: Foreign spot penalty
foreign_penalty.description: Penalty in dB for spots of other devices (0 = off; default: configured).

map_room.name: Map room to area
map_room.description: Move all spots of a free-text room to a Home Assistant area.

scanner_without_area.title: Some Bluetooth Proxies don't have an AREA
scanner_without_area.description:
Bermuda requires all bluetooth proxies to have a valid area assigned in order to work correctly. Assign an area by visiting each proxy's device page (via `Devices and Services`), and click the pencil icon in the top-right to assign an area. The following proxies are missing an area assignment:

{scannerlist}
